system.description:
This grisly power has helped many a voivode hold onto her domain. Normally it is very difficult to achieve precise duplication of a specific person through Vicissitude alone; with this power, however, a Tzimisce may graft the skin of a flayed victim onto her own, enabling her to pose flawlessly as the skinned person. In this manner Tzimisce infiltrate the halls of the mighty.

System: The Tzimisce first uses Vicissitude (and a sharp knife or two) to flay a victim, then invokes this power while naked and wrapped in the victim's bloody skin. The skin grafts onto the Fiend's own, granting an automatic, perfect Vicissitude duplication of the victim with no roll required. The Fiend may maintain the stolen shape as long as she likes; once discarded, the skin peels away and the disguise ends. A Tzimisce with this power can maintain a mental catalog of previously imprinted shapes (limited by memory) and don any of them again in moments without needing a fresh victim.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
system.duration: Until the Fiend discards the shape
